scope: Local numerical-stability and accuracy experiment after the first2021/2022challenge. No operational promotion or modification of frozen artifacts.
trigger: Independent interval integration changed rain values by at most6.4e-13 and crossed tree thresholds in203predictions, maximum0.029309652m, without changing any hit classification. The largest case crosses a Tainhas:P48 threshold near76.2868852459016mm; this is not restricted to zero rainfall.
fixed_rule: For exact120-column observed matrices only, copy the array and round columns45..119 (rain amounts/lags and coverage fractions) to8decimal places using numpy.round(decimals=8), canonicalize signedzero. Apply after the existing admissibility/coverage masks, identically before fitting and prediction. Keep columns0..44, base, truth, timestamps and all NaN masks unchanged. No clipping, imputation, changed rainfall coverage threshold or altered source delays.
precision_rationale: A fixed1e-8 numerical grid is several orders larger than the observed floating discrepancies while perturbing a rain amount or coverage feature by no more than about5e-9 in its current units. This is a computational representation, not a statement about sensor resolution or physical precision. Do not search alternative precisions against forecast errors.
pre_fit_gate: Before fitting, compare normalized original and independent reconstructed2021/2022matrices exactly including NaNs, audit nonrain and missingness preservation, and record maximum perturbation. If equality fails, report it and do not tune the grid using model performance.
training: Fit48 new120-column models: original membership and original+all eligible2020 membership, each validation/test phase andh1..12. Reuse the frozen training masks, weights, chronological order, leaf/loss choices and all other hyperparameters from the original120 and2020augmentation experiments. Only rain numeric representation changes. No2021/2022/2023/2024training additions or parameter search.
controls: Reproduce all48 original frozen models exactly on their unmodified inputs before comparison. Preserve all existing prediction rows and control forecasts. Compare normalized original vs raw original and normalized+2020 vs raw+2020; never compare different training membership to attribute a normalization effect.
evaluation: All102084 original2025/2026scheduled rows, unchanged two folds and October-boundary rule. Also replay test-phase models on all26340previous2021/2022challenge rows as an explicitly reused development diagnostic, not an unseen holdout. Allh1..12, all andobserved>=7m, full_schedule/complete24/missing24, failures retained in observed-target denominator. Report hits<=0.50m,MAE,bias,P98,max and coverage. No per-horizon mixing or favorable-window selection.
reproducibility: Require normalized original and reconstructed reserved inputs to give identical predictions for the new models, with model/input/version hashes. Deterministic reconstruction is not evidence of hydrological accuracy or the98percent goal.
consequences: The2021/2022results have now informed an experiment. They are development diagnostics for this change and cannot be advertised as a new independent test. Prior first-challenge artifacts remain unchanged.
